evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep asks 'do you have about fifteen minutes for us to kind of walk through your move?' but never frames the 10–15 minute time-boxed promise, never mentions 'quote you can depend on,' and never explicitly waits for a yes before jumping into probing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep skips directly to verifying address and property type without asking 'what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (condo), stories/floor (implicit in 3-bed condo), number of rooms (3 bedroom), walking distance (street parking discussed), additional rooms (none beyond what listed), special considerations (none), additional stops (verified two locations). All seven covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep asks 'do you need any help, help with packing on that day?' Customer declines, saying he's already packing.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked. No mention of typical box count or overflow check.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives hourly rate ($204/hour), estimated duration (5–6 hours with 45-minute drive), and range ($1,095–$1,299). Personalizes slightly by noting the drive time affects total cost. Both anchor and personalization present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses $75 trip fee upfront, mentions $204/hour includes wrapping, padding, taxes, insurance, travel. Also states '2.5 hour minimum' and 'you only pay for the time you use.' No deposit due, free cancellation/modifications disclosed. Both fee transparency and 'not a guess' commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moves directly from pricing into 'did you want to go ahead and reserve the truck?' with no 'does that feel fair?' pause.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep mentions 'our on-time guarantee' and references 'truck available starting first thing in the morning, between 8:00 and 8:30' but never specifies the discount terms (starts discounting immediately if late). Vague delivery.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep states 'no damage coverage that does cover-up to $2,000 for any kind of incidentals' and mentions 'our movers feature and patches' but does not clearly state 'no deductible / no fine print' framing or that it's 'built into the rate, not an add-on.' Partial delivery.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No closing loop. Rep does not ask 'does that put those to rest?' after covering the two promises. No summary or confirmation that concerns have been addressed.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'Did you have any other questions that I could help with?' — a throwaway 'any questions' format, not a genuine 'what's still concerning you?' probe.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' appears in the call.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep says 'did you want to go ahead and at least reserve the truck today?' — framed with a built-in out ('at least reserve the truck' implies a softer alternative; no direct 'would you like our help with your move?'). With out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep states 'There is no deposit due today. There, you don't pay for anything until after the move has been completed.' Confirms no-deposit and free cancellation.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date confirmed (Thursday October 22nd). Time window confirmed (8:00–8:30). Addresses partially confirmed (pickup at 3121 park lane, drop at 1976 mystic way). Phone number not confirmed. Crew size mentioned ($204 rate includes 'two movers and 26 foot truck') but not explicitly confirmed as part of booking. Notes for crew about customer concerns not left. Partial confirmation.

top_strength: Chauntelle gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, rooms, major furniture, parking constraints, additional stops) with clear, systematic probing that would support an accurate estimate.
coaching_note: Section 2 — skip the 'any concerns?' throwaway in Section 1 and ask a genuine 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' before jumping into probing; this call never discovered what the customer actually cares about, which left no foundation for the rest of the pitch.
